correctness.rationale: The LCF definition generates the stated cubic 27-edge graph. Fresh enumeration reproduced the complete 783-cycle census, girth six, and the six unordered triples of disjoint hexagons. Each admissible triple has to partition the graph since the three cycle lengths total at least 18. The natural comparison in Theorem 4.5 and the reduced inclusion of Proposition 4.9 identify the reduced chain model with integral configuration-space homology. In weight one, a cycle subgraph has its primitive oriented loop chain given by the telescoping signed half-edge differences; inside the disjoint union of a triple the one-particle-per-component summand is the tensor product of the three loop complexes. Via the inclusion into the Pappus graph, its fundamental chain is the signed product in the submitted model, not merely an arbitrary closed chain with the same weight. The local tensor factors permit at most one degree-one choice at each vertex, and reordering contributions uses the Koszul signs. Fresh reconstruction gives the stated six coordinate rows and determinant −1, so coordinate projection followed by the inverse of that unit minor gives an integral retraction onto the six chains. The retraction restricts to the kernel since the six products are cycles. Independently rebuilt integer differential: 6,528 columns, 16,524 rows, 39,168 nonzero entries; 6,515 signed-unit pivots followed by exact rational elimination of rank six. The independent pivot schedule leaves five zeros and eight active columns, rather than the submitted schedule's four and nine; the split is not invariant and gives the same total rank 6,521. The submitted rank logic is sound: exact residual relations with a unit coordinate minor bound the rank above and the field pivots bound it below, without a field-to-integral torsion inference. Since there is no weight-three degree-four chain, H_3 is the free rank-seven kernel, and the integral retraction gives the free cyclic quotient. value.rationale: The canonical cubic graph and the top degree for three particles give a natural test of generation by geometric independent motion. Unlike the known ambient rank or rational symmetry, this determines the integral deficiency: exactly one free direction remains even after saturation of the full set of disjoint-cycle products. The comparison with the two-particle generation result shows why the specific invariant matters. The conclusion is a finite exact obstruction in a specified sense, not a new general phenomenon or a claim to have constructed an embedded representative of the missing direction.
